name: fsharpened
description: F# language server, Fantomas formatting and FSharpened diagnostics for VS Code. Local-only: no network, no telemetry.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: FSharpened starts external programs (FsAutoComplete, Fantomas, the fsh CLI, Python for the local CI) found through settings, .config/dotnet-tools.json or PATH. None of that runs until you trust the workspace; syntax and the Doctor report still work.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The tools run as local processes on files on disk, so a virtual file system (vscode.dev, remote repositories) is not supported.

fsharpened.languageServer.enabled.markdownDescription: Start the FsAutoComplete language server for F# files (trusted workspaces only).

fsharpened.languageServer.path.markdownDescription: FsAutoComplete executable. Empty: use the `fsautocomplete` tool from `.config/dotnet-tools.json` (run `dotnet tool restore`), then `fsautocomplete` on `PATH`.

fsharpened.languageServer.trace.description: Trace the language client/server traffic into the FSharpened output channel.

fsharpened.fantomas.path.markdownDescription: Fantomas executable. Empty: `dotnet fantomas` from `.config/dotnet-tools.json`, then `fantomas` on `PATH`. The workspace's `.editorconfig` is honoured.

fsharpened.fantomas.formatOnSave.markdownDescription: Format F# files with Fantomas when they are saved. (`editor.formatOnSave` also works and uses the same formatter.)

fsharpened.fsh.path.markdownDescription: The `fsh` command line (an executable, or `fsh.dll`, which is run with `dotnet`). Empty: `dotnet fsh` from `.config/dotnet-tools.json`, then `fsh` on `PATH`.

fsharpened.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Show FSharpened diagnostics (from `fsh analyze --format json`) as problems.

fsharpened.diagnostics.runOnSave.description: Analyze a file when it is saved.

fsharpened.diagnostics.runOnOpen.description: Analyze a file when it is opened.

fsharpened.python.path.markdownDescription: Python 3 used for `FSharpened: Run local CI`. Empty: the first of `python3`, `python`, `py` on `PATH`.

fsharpened.ci.profile.markdownDescription: Profile for `FSharpened: Run local CI` (`python tools/ci/fsh_ci.py run --profile <profile>`). See docs/operations/local-ci.md.

fsharpened.toolTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a formatting or analysis run may take before it is stopped.
